title: Stress-Testing Dynamical and Generative Downscaling Using Subseasonal Extreme Precipitation Forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2609.11696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coarse spatial resolution limits the ability of subseasonal prediction models to resolve extreme precipitation. Downscaling with either dynamical or deep generative models can overcome this issue, but the comparative performance of these models for extremes across different atmospheric regimes remains poorly understood. In this work, we evaluate the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model against a diffusion-based generative model by downscaling two physically distinct, extreme precipitation events up to lead times of 3 weeks. For a fair comparison with WRF, which can downscale boundary conditions from different driving models without model-specific training, the diffusion model is trained in an unpaired fashion. Both approaches improve upon the raw European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts forecasts, in comparison to fused rain gauge-radar observations in Switzerland (CombiPrecip), but exhibit regime-dependent strengths.

translated_title: 利用次季节极端降水预报对动力降尺度和生成式降尺度进行压力测试
translated_abstract: 粗糙的空间分辨率限制了次季节预测模型解析极端降水的能力。使用动力模型或深度生成模型进行降尺度可以克服这一问题，但这些模型在不同大气环流形势下对极端天气的相对性能仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们通过降尺度两个物理上截然不同的极端降水事件（预报时效长达3周），将天气研究与预报（WRF）模型与基于扩散模型的生成式模型进行对比评估。为了与WRF进行公平比较——WRF无需针对特定驱动模型进行训练即可对来自不同驱动模型的边界条件进行降尺度——扩散模型采用非配对方式训练。与瑞士融合雨量计-雷达观测数据（CombiPrecip）相比，两种方法均优于欧洲中期天气预报中心的原始预报，但各自表现出依赖于大气环流形势的优势。
tldr: 该研究首次通过长达3周预报时效的极端降水事件，对比评估了动力降尺度模型WRF与非配对训练的扩散生成模型，发现两者均优于原始预报但各有依赖于大气环流形势的优势。
en_tdlr: This study stress-tests dynamical (WRF) versus unpaired diffusion-based generative downscaling on subseasonal extreme precipitation forecasts up to 3-week lead times, finding both improve upon raw forecasts but exhibit regime-dependent strengths.
